messages:
elaine: Heads-up — we’re launching a new dedicated GPU offering and a reservation model change. Today we opened G770x dedicated pools in eu-south-1 (Milan) and eu-west-3 (Paris). These are tuned for medium-latency, cost-efficient inference for batch and streaming workloads. :tada:

elaine: What’s changing: we’re introducing "reserved buckets" — time-block reservations that replace the old ad-hoc burst windows. Buckets provide guaranteed throughput with a simple hourly commit and elastic burst attachments. This is a policy+billing change; see runbook below.

elaine: Quick notes:
- Regions: eu-south-1, eu-west-3
- GPU type: G770x (8x32GB, mixed-precision optimized)
- Reservation min: 2 hours, billing by hourly commit
- Fairshare: new per-team weight; idle reclaim after 20m of 0% utilization
- Rollout: gradual — will start with customers on Dedicated beta and expand

elaine: If you have Dedicated reservations already, we’ll migrate them to buckets automatically unless you opt-out. Migration window: next 7 days. Expect no interruption for pinned models. See migration CLI below.

elaine: Migration CLI example:
```
# migrate existing reservations to buckets
rwctl reservations migrate --from=reserved --to=buckets --region=eu-south-1 --team=infra-team
```

elaine: Billing example: hourly commit charged at commit rate, burst usage billed at on-demand delta. More on billing in the docs.

jeff: Do these buckets have SLA parity with existing reserved pools? What about preemptible behavior?

elaine: SLA: committed buckets carry the same uptime SLA as reserved pools (SLA docs linked). Burst attachments are best-effort and can be preempted during constrained windows. If you need non-preemptible capacity, request a Dedicated locked pool via support.

maria: For customers that rely on warm pools and prefix cache, any changes to KV cache handling?

alan: Cache behavior unchanged — warm pools and cache affinity are preserved. Buckets add a soft reclaim; we won't drop KV cache unless a node is reclaimed for another bucket and we fail over. Ops will monitor spill metrics.

ops-bot: Scheduled rollout task created: task/rollout-2501234567 at 2026-05-14T09:00Z — phased region enablement and telemetry checks.

sam: doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated/buckets-and-g770x — please add any missed edge-cases to the notes. I'll run a post-rollout smoke next week.

jeff: Thanks — will loop in sales for quoting changes. :+1:

elaine: Thanks all. Ping me or #product-dedicated if you need early access or have migration blockers.
